text:
maya: kicking off shadow + staged smokecheck for model v3.2-quant8 on staging. plan: 1) 1k shadow traffic, 2) smoke eval set (1000 prompts), 3) run perf and quality gates. ping @ci-bot to start the jobs.

ci-bot: started run job=4521, shadow_mode=true, eval_suite=smoke_v2, sample=1000. logs: /jobs/4521/logs

oliver: quick Q — can we toggle prefix_cache for this run? last quant experiment showed cache interaction noise. set prefix_cache=false for the smoke eval.

ci-bot: updated job=4521 config: {"prefix_cache":false,"batching":"small","quant":"int8","sample":1000}

sara-ml: proposing gating thresholds for auto-fallback: 
- hallucination_rate_delta_abs >= 1.0% -> fail
- quality_score_drop_abs >= 0.4 -> fail (we measure composite QA-score)
- avg_latency_increase_rel >= 25% -> fail
Also require min_samples=500 and rolling_window=30m.

derek: +1 to rolling window and min_samples. also require p95_latency_check: if p95 increases by >50% -> fail. keep the gates conservative for staging.

maya: sounds good. here's the rollout config snippet I'll attach to the job: 
```
{
  "model_version": "v3.2-quant8",
  "shadow": true,
  "gates": {
    "hallucination_abs": 0.01,
    "quality_abs": 0.4,
    "avg_latency_rel": 0.25,
    "p95_latency_rel": 0.5,
    "min_samples": 500,
    "rolling_window_mins": 30
  }
}
```

ci-bot: smoke eval complete for job=4521. results summary: n=1000. avg_latency=123ms (baseline 95ms, +29.5%), p95=340ms (baseline 210ms, +61.9%), quality_score=0.82 (baseline 1.18, -0.36), hallucination_rate=3.2% (baseline 1.6%, +1.6pp). detailed metrics: /jobs/4521/results.json

oliver: Oof. quality drop -0.36 (close to the 0.4 gate but below?) we set gate 0.4 absolute, this is 0.36 -> technically pass quality gate but other signals are bad.

sara-ml: hallucination delta is +1.6pp which exceeds the 1.0% absolute gate -> fail. also p95 up >50% -> fail. That should trigger auto-fallback per config.

derek: confirm we have min_samples (1000) and rolling_window satisfied. yes. So fallback should be triggered automatically.

ci-bot: gate_evaluation: {"hallucination_pass":false,"quality_pass":true,"avg_latency_pass":false,"p95_pass":false,"final":false}. Action: initiating fallback to v3.1 stable variant. rollback_job=4521-rollback started.

maya: initiating notify to oncall and deployment pipeline. @eng-oncall please note automatic fallback triggered by staging smoke gates.

oliver: can we capture a small diff-run with prefix_cache=true to isolate cache interaction? schedule quick ablation run with 200 samples.

ci-bot: ablation job=4522 scheduled with sample=200, prefix_cache=true.

sara-ml: please also capture top-k token-level divergence and a handful of failing prompt ids for manual triage. want to see if hallucinations are content-specific.

ci-bot: attached artifacts: /jobs/4521/artifacts/failed_prompts.csv ; /jobs/4521/artifacts/token_divergence.tsv

derek: thanks. next steps: 1) triage failed prompts, 2) run ablation 4522 and compare, 3) if cache flips the signal open a follow-up quantization debug ticket. 4) update model onboarding doc with this smokecheck config.

maya: noted. I'll update the onboarding checklist and add the exact gate JSON. thanks all. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: rollback job=4521-rollback completed, traffic restored to v3.1. incident-note: automatic_staging_fallback, triggers=[hallucination_abs,p95_latency_rel], timestamp=2076543810

sara-ml: logging this thread for the eval-runbook, will attach to the model onboarding PR.

maya: closing loop — tracking ticket ML-789 for root cause and follow-ups.

oliver: cool, great run. short but useful data.

ci-bot: job summary exported: /jobs/4521/summary.json
